elements.title: So You Want to See the President! (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that So You Want to See the President! by Norman Rockwell was displayed in the West Wing during seven U.S. presidential administrations?

elements.title: Jos Murer (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Jos Murer's 450-year-old bird's-eye plan of Zurich is still used to determine how the city's buildings and streets originally looked?

elements.contents: ... that Donald Trump said he "had the greatest time" at the 2011 White House Correspondents' Dinner, despite being mocked by Barack Obama?
